verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe an async background crawl job handling up to 25,000 pages with progress tracking and retrieval on completion, plus rate-limit headers and partial-result timeout handling that support reliability at scale. However, this is framed as crawling one site rather than an arbitrary list of thousands of distinct URLs, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence confirming real-world throughput or reliability at that scale. Missing for 10: evidence of scraping an arbitrary batch/list of thousands of URLs (not just one site's crawl), independent benchmarks or user reports validating async batch reliability at scale.
